subject.title: feat(provider): add Sealos Devbox SSH-lease provider

question: Should Crabbox accept this built-in Sealos DevBox provider contract, including CRD mutation, DevBox-owned Secret key reads, SSHGate/NodePort routing, and retained-release semantics, after the deadcode and changelog blockers are removed?
rationale: The patch is coherent and has live proof, but automation should not approve a new provider authentication and Kubernetes resource-deletion boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve After Mechanical Fixes
options.body: Remove the unreachable helpers and release-owned changelog edits, then let a maintainer explicitly own the CRD, Secret, SSH routing, and retained-release contract before merge.

options.title: Require Stronger Proof Artifact
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or linked artifact if the PR-body live proof is not enough for this hosted Sealos environment.

options.title: Pause For Contract Clarity
options.body: Keep this PR open with https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/365 until the supported Sealos automation and SSH routing surface is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Approve After Mechanical Fixes
recommendation.body: Remove the unreachable helpers and release-owned changelog edits, then let a maintainer explicitly own the CRD, Secret, SSH routing, and retained-release contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current history signal for provider lifecycle safety, release ownership, and the latest Sealos hardening commits.
